exposure: Delivery before publication of periviable birth guidelines (Epoch 1)
Delivery after publication of periviable birth guidelines (Epoch 2)
outcome: Neonatal interventions (NICU admission, ventilation, surfactant, and antibiotic administration)
Maternal adverse outcomes (ICU admission, transfusion, hysterectomy, uterine rupture)
cohort: Singleton live births delivered between 22 0/7 and 23 6/7 weeks of gestation in the United States
finding: Cesarean delivery rates at 23 weeks gestation and composite neonatal interventions increased after the publication of periviable birth guidelines, while a slight reduction in neonatal mortality was observed.
